Open implementations are only mentioned for DWN (dwn2rtl) and only for FPGA deployment, not CPU.
Results on text data are not reported for any of the listed families in these sources.
BTHOWeN is not mentioned in any provided source.
ULEEN and WiSARD results are only shown on FPGA or in open-set recognition without CPU cost analysis.
Tabular results are only explicitly noted for DWN and PolyLUT (network intrusion detection).
